concept.name: Organization
concept.definition: A structured, persistent group of people (and resources) acting together to pursue one or more shared goals, recognised as a single entity.

provenance.note: Scope aligned to a social endurant with its own identity.

property.name: legalName
property.definition: The registered or officially recognised name of the organisation.

property.name: foundingDate
property.definition: The calendar date on which the organisation was established.

role.name: Employee
role.definition: The role of a person engaged under a contract of employment by an organisation.

provenance.source: ILO International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08), conceptual framework
provenance.note: Employment is a contextual, time-bounded relation, modelled as a role.

property.name: employeeId
property.definition: The identifier the employing organisation assigns to the holder.

property.name: hiredOn
property.definition: The date from which the employment relation is in effect.
